recall_prompt: Say how you would count the injections from a five-element set to a seven-element set — what an injection is as a count, and the number.
insider_note: An injection gives the 5 elements different images chosen from 7, and which element takes which image matters — that sentence is the first mark, and it forces ⁷P₅ = 2520, not ⁷C₅ and not 7⁵.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: An injection is an arrangement of images
steps.margin_note: First mark. An injection sends the 5 elements of A to 5 DIFFERENT elements of B. Choosing and assigning 5 different images from 7 is ⁷P₅.
steps.memory_tip: Different images AND which element gets which — that is an arrangement, ⁷P₅, not ⁷C₅.
lines: An injection sends the 5 elements of A to
5 different images chosen from the 7 in B.

recall.must_convey: That an injection needs 5 different images from B, so the count is 7 P 5.
accept: an injection gives the five elements five different images out of seven so it is seven P five
different images for different elements, seven P five
one to one means no image repeats, so it is a permutation seven P five
injection ante different images, seven P five
the number of injections is n P r with n seven and r five

steps.why: Injective means no two elements share an image, so the images are 5 different elements of B in a definite order (element by element). That ordered choice is a permutation, not a combination.
common_mistakes: Using ⁷C₅ = 21 — which element gets which image matters, so it is ⁷P₅.
Using 7⁵, which allows repeated images and counts all functions.

steps.label: Evaluate ⁷P₅
steps.memory_tip: ⁷P₅ = 7·6·5·4·3 = 2520. Five factors, counting down from 7.

recall.must_convey: That 7 P 5 is 7 times 6 times 5 times 4 times 3 = 2520.
accept: seven P five is seven into six into five into four into three which is two thousand five hundred twenty
seven six five four three multiplied gives two five two zero
seven P five two thousand five hundred twenty
the answer is two thousand five hundred and twenty

steps.why: ⁿPᵣ is the product of r factors counting down from n; five factors from 7 give 2520.
common_mistakes: Dividing by 5! by habit and answering 21.
